DESCRIPTION: SMS coveralls are made of a durable, three-layer fabric that protects against light liquid splashes and sprays, while also keeping you cool for extended periods. The durable, three-layer SMS fabric (Spunbond Meltblown Spunbond) protects against light liquid splashes and sprays and provides a superior particulate barrier. The outermost layer of spunbond polypropylene provides strength, while the middle layer of meltblown polypropylene provides liquid resistance via a microporous film. This film also allows air to flow through freely, creating a more breathable garment that helps prevent heat stress. A storm flap over the zipper adds an extra layer of protection, preventing liquids and other contaminants from entering through exposed zipper seams. An attached hood helps protect the neck and shoulders, while secure elastic wrists and ankles work together to keep contaminants from entering high-movement areas.

DESCRIPTION: SMS Coveralls are lightweight, breathable, and provide an excellent particulate barrier. The outermost layer of spunbond polypropylene provides strength, while the middle layer of meltblown polypropylene provides liquid resistance via a microporous film. This film also allows air to flow through freely, creating a more breathable garment that helps prevent heat stress. A storm flap over the zipper adds an extra layer of protection, preventing liquids and other contaminants from entering through exposed zipper seams. With an attached hood and boots, you’re protected from head-to-toe.

A storm flap over the zipper adds an extra layer of protection, preventing liquids and other contaminants from entering through exposed zipper seams. PRODUCT_NAME: White SMS Coverall with Attached Hood & Boot, Size M
DESCRIPTION: SMS Coveralls are lightweight, breathable, and provide an excellent particulate barrier. This film also allows air to flow through freely, creating a more breathable garment that helps prevent heat stress. A storm flap over the zipper adds an extra layer of protection, preventing liquids and other contaminants from entering through exposed zipper seams. With an attached hood and boots, you’re protected from head-to-toe.

DESCRIPTION:
Latex free / low lint coverall for use in some critical / clean environments, and many industrial applications. Nonwoven fabric is durable, cloth-like and cool to wear. • ISO Cleanroom Class: 7 / Helmke Drum Testing IEST-RP-CC003.3

• Color: White
• Packaging: Neatly folded and packed 25 pieces per case in a sealed inner poly-bag

• Grab Strength: MD: 18 lbs, XD: 13lbs (ASTM D751)

• Puncture/Tear: MD: 5.2 lbs, XD: 8.9lbs (ASTM D2582)
• Water Resistance: Not Recommended
• Breathability: 6856gm/m2, 24 hrs (ASTM E96-80)
• Flammability: Class 1 (CPSC 1610)

DESCRIPTION: ProShield® 6 SFR is a cost-efficient disposable overgarment designed to help protect and preserve primary flame resistant garments. ProShield® 6 SFR garments are intended to be worn over primary flame resistant garments to provide a barrier against non-hazardous particles and aerosols.
